text: A customer buys a phone and a charger. Maryam takes it.
Maryam opens Sell from the tools to ring up the order.
The Nova X5 comes in storage and colours. Tap Choose.
She picks the storage, 128 GB, and the colour, Blue.
It shows 128 GB, Blue and how many are left. Add one.
One charger at ₦6,500: tap One more once.
The bar shows two things and ₦191,500. Tap Next.
Maryam chooses how it was paid: Transfer, as the customer did.
Tap Record the sale to save it.
